cards.example_en: Take your time. The next train comes in ten minutes.
cards.example_ko: 천천히 해. 다음 기차는 10분 뒤에 와.

cards.example_en: I'm on my way. I'll meet you by the door.
cards.example_ko: 지금 가는 중이야. 문 앞에서 만나자.

cards.example_en: That makes sense. Let's start with the smaller task.
cards.example_ko: 이해가 돼. 더 작은 일부터 시작하자.

cards.example_en: I'm not sure yet. Can I tell you tomorrow?
cards.example_ko: 아직 확실하지 않아. 내일 말해도 될까?

cards.example_en: Let me check the schedule before we book a table.
cards.example_ko: 테이블을 예약하기 전에 일정을 확인해 볼게.

cards.example_en: We can walk or take the bus. It's up to you.
cards.example_ko: 걸어도 되고 버스를 타도 돼. 네가 결정해.

cards.expression: I've got a lot on my plate
cards.example_en: I've got a lot on my plate this week, so let's meet next week.
cards.example_ko: 이번 주에는 할 일이 많으니 다음 주에 만나자.

cards.example_en: Keep me posted when you hear back from the team.
I've never made bread, but I'll give it a try.
cards.example_ko: 빵을 만들어 본 적은 없지만 한번 해 볼게.

cards.example_en: You stayed to help me clean up. I really appreciate it.
We've finished the first draft. Let's call it a day.
You don't need to learn everything today. One step at a time.
cards.example_ko: 오늘 모든 것을 배울 필요는 없어. 한 단계씩 해 보자.
